scenes.say: Ever had a project work on your laptop, but fail everywhere else? Let’s fix that.

scenes.label: pip
scenes.sub: pip is Python’s standard package manager.
scenes.say: Pip is the tool every Python dev uses to install packages. It’s your starting point for managing dependencies.

scenes.title: From a requirements file
scenes.say: You can install everything your project needs by running pip with your requirements file.
Requirements files list what you need, but lock files freeze the exact versions. That means everyone gets the same setup, every time.

scenes.question: What’s a lock file for?
scenes.right: It records the exact versions of all dependencies, so your project runs the same everywhere.
scenes.say: Interviewers love this one: a lock file isn’t just a list. It’s your guarantee of consistency across machines and deployments.
